research: https://www.bloopanimation.com/the-art-of-smear-frames/ — smear frames: a limb goes between two poses in one frame, which is what sells extreme speed; a model gets this as motion blur, so ask for a 'blur' leg and a body that is 'a streak'

https://sites.google.com/view/art379/lessons/anticipation-impacts — action timing: a held wind-up, then one or two frames of the limb going forward, then a long reaction. So the START FRAME should be the wind-up (leg already cocked), and the prompt spends its words on the release and the hold after

https://fiveable.me/2d-animation/unit-10/manipulating-timing-spacing-comedic-dramatic-effect/study-guide/VThqosnSzDJFFmO6 — comic timing: fast only reads as fast next to slow; a still pause before and a long frozen hold after make the instant gag land

https://playbooks.com/skills/dylantarre/animation-principles/timing-mastery — rule of thumb: ~2 frames of contact, 12+ frames of settle; so: contact and launch in under half a second, then a long hold on the rocking car

https://www.veo3gen.app/blog/timestamp-prompting-for-ai-video-2026-a-creator-workflow-to-direct-beat-by-beat- — timestamped beats ([00:00-00:01]) give each segment one main action and one camera instruction; repeat the identity/scene anchors; works with a start-frame image

https://dev.to/akaranjkar08/veo-31-developer-guide-timestamp-prompting-multi-shot-video-and-full-api-june-2026-3l5i — timestamp prompting inside one 8 s call; the start image anchors subject and setting, the prompt says only what happens after it
https://magichour.ai/blog/how-to-prompt-veo-3-for-the-best-results — one primary action per shot and a locked camera first, so the model's effort goes into the action and not into a camera move
https://lumalabs.ai/news/funny-ai-video-prompts — framing a gag as cartoon physics lets the model exaggerate and lets glitches read as the joke

https://www.insmind.com/blog/funny-ai-video-prompts-tested-examples — comedy prompts that work: clear character, one specific action, an absurd twist, then style words ('exaggerated cartoon physics, playful')

Note: I did not look for ways round Flow's safety filter and these prompts are not built to trick it. Each one says plainly what happens: a playful, harmless comic foot-nudge, nobody hurt. The leg motion is written as everyday movement (a dancer's leg extension, a penalty swing, a doorman's helping foot), which is also the clearest way to tell the model the exact path of the leg.
notes: 1) Every motion prompt puts the contact and the launch in [00:00-00:01] and spends the rest on a hold. Expect Omni to still pad: in Premiere, cut from the first frame of the leg moving, speed-ramp the contact-to-gone stretch to 200-400% if it is slower than ~8 frames at 24 fps, then sit 12-20 frames on the rocking car and cut to the end card. If the clip has a slow float, cut the float out and jump-cut him from 'at the door' to 'gone'; the jump reads as speed. 2) If the lad turns round or the figure faces camera, keep only the frames before it happens; the gag only needs about 1 s. 3) Sound does the contact: a cartoon 'thwump' or slide-whistle-up on the contact frame, a muffled seat-bounce plus car-spring creak as he lands, then silence for the hold. Add it in the edit (Flow sound is a bonus, not relied on). 4) Optional one-frame white or motion-blur smear on the contact frame in Premiere (a Directional Blur on two frames) if the model's leg is too clean. 5) The still keeps the lad a pace back from the open rear door so there is room to fly; CA2-a must be attached as the reference for both people, the taxi and the street.

stagings.idea: The dancer's extension. The figure stands side-on with one knee drawn up high and folded, poised like a dancer about to unfold a leg; the lad stands a pace in front of the open back door with his back to him. The leg unfolds dead straight, the sole of the shoe meets the seat of his jeans, and he is gone into the cab in a blink.
stagings.still: Vertical 9:16 night street, long lens, very shallow focus, the background melted into big soft amber, red, pink and cyan bokeh, inky blacks, light only from signs, shop windows and street lamps. The silver taxi stands at the kerb, its rear door wide open, glowing yellow TAXI roof sign. The young man in the white shirt stands one pace back from the open door, facing into the car, his back and backside to camera-left, arms loose. Behind him, side-on to camera, the figure in the lab coat balances on one leg, the other knee drawn high and folded tight at his chest, sole of the shoe aimed at the seat of the young man's jeans, gloved hands out for balance, calm as a dancer. Thanks.
stagings.motion: Camera locked. [00:00-00:01] The figure in the lab coat unfolds his raised leg dead straight in a blur, the sole of his shoe pats the seat of the young man's jeans, and the young man zips head-first through the open door into the back seat like a cork from a bottle, gone in an instant, feet last. Comic cartoon physics, nobody hurt. [00:01-00:08] The taxi rocks on its springs; the figure holds the straight leg out, motionless, side-on. Thanks.

stagings.idea: The penalty. The figure is caught at the top of a footballer's swing: planted foot down, the other leg drawn right back behind him like a striker about to take a penalty. The lad is the ball. The leg swings through, he sails into the back seat like a ball into the net.
stagings.still: Vertical 9:16, night city street on a long lens, very shallow focus, warm amber and red bokeh with touches of pink and cyan, deep black sky, lit only by street lamps and shop signs. The silver taxi waits at the kerb with its rear door open and a plain glowing TAXI roof sign. The young man in the white shirt stands a step back from the doorway, facing the car, swaying slightly, his backside toward the figure. The figure in the lab coat, side-on to camera, is frozen at the top of a footballer's penalty run-up: planted foot beside the young man, swinging leg drawn far back behind him, arms flung out, coat flaring, eyes on the target. Thanks.
stagings.motion: Static camera. [00:00-00:01] The figure in the lab coat swings his drawn-back leg through like a footballer's penalty, a fast blur; his shoe meets the seat of the young man's jeans and the young man sails head-first through the open door onto the back seat like a ball into the net, a white streak, gone. Playful slapstick, nobody hurt. [00:01-00:08] The taxi bounces on its springs; the figure holds his follow-through pose, side-on, perfectly still. Thanks.

stagings.idea: The doorman's helping foot. The figure stands side-on with one gloved hand holding the top of the open taxi door like a polite doorman and one foot already lifted behind the lad, knee bent, toe pointed. A courteous, deadpan assist: the foot flicks forward, the lad is posted into the cab like a letter, and the doorman shuts the door.

The silver taxi at the kerb, rear door swung wide, plain yellow TAXI roof sign glowing. The figure in the lab coat stands side-on to camera at the door's edge, one gloved hand resting on top of the open door like a hotel doorman, the other behind his back, one foot lifted behind the young man, knee bent, toe pointed, deadpan.
